message.content:
Based on a visual comparison of the web reference (Image 1) and the Android implementation (Image 2), here are the remaining differences ranked by visual impact:

1.  **Album Art & Layout Structure:** The most significant difference is the content of the main image area. Image 1 displays a specific, detailed album cover ("Jazz Cabbage") with text overlays ("WOOLI", "CYCLOPS") inside the image frame. Image 2 displays a generic placeholder icon (musical note) on a solid gradient background. Additionally, the aspect ratio and corner radius of the image container differ slightly (Image 1 is more rectangular/square with sharper corners relative to its size, Image 2 has more pronounced rounded corners).
2.  **Typography & Text Hierarchy:** The track title in Image 1 is "WOOLI & CYCLOPS - JAZZ CABBAGE" (multi-line, all caps for artist, mixed case for title). In Image 2, it is simply "Jazz Cabbage" (single line). The metadata text also differs ("Wooli" vs "Wooli & Cyclops").
3.  **Progress Bar & Time Display:** The progress bar styling differs. Image 1 shows a thin line with a small square thumb/handle at the start. Image 2 shows a thicker bar with a large circular thumb in the middle. The time format also differs (Image 1: "0:02", Image 2: "0:17").
4.  **Control Bar Iconography:** The bottom row of action icons is different. Image 1 contains icons for "Like/Dislike" (thumbs up/down), "Lyrics" (quotation marks), "Connect" (device with wifi), "Queue" (list with music note), "Sleep Timer" (clock), and "Share". Image 2 contains icons for "Microphone", "Lyrics", "Speed" (1x), "Pitch/Equalizer" (sliders), and "Share".
5.  **Header Text:** The header text differs slightly ("СЕЙЧАС ИГРАЕТ - ОЧЕРЕДЬ" in Image 1 vs "Сейчас играет - 1" in Image 2).

PARITY: 60
